toss-lg.label: Share of IPL matches won by the toss winner
toss-lg.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
toss-lg.query: SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1_id IN (2,15) OR m.team2_id IN (2,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END inv, CASE WHEN m.toss_winner_id IN (2,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END tw, m.toss_decision dec, CASE WHEN m.winner_id = m.toss_winner_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END tossWon, CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (2,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year FROM matches m WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL
